newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa to set up mining resource bank - report.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa to set up mining resource bank - report.

text.p: South Africa's first resource bank, dedicated to funding mining projects, is currently being set up, Business Day reported on Friday.
The newspaper said the bank would be a one billion rand venture to be headed by Randgold and Exploration Company Ltd commercial director Brett Kebble.
The report said the move is widely believed to anticipate black empowerment initiatives similiar to the recent purchase of the controlling stake in JCI Ltd by Saflife.
Kebble told Business Day that the proposed bank would complement financial institutions in providing adequate funding for resource projects.
He said he expected extensive changes to the South African mining industry over the next few years and the resource bank would be positioned to participate in and take advantage of this.
